correctness.rationale: The forest shattering iff is proved by the cyclic weak-inequality obstruction and acyclic forest orientations. The complete ordered-Bell counts 1,3,13,75, and tie count 13 on four labels, imply the exact small upper bounds; the explicit depth-three and depth-five full binary certificates with 8 and 32 leaf witnesses are checked by independent exhaustive ordered-block enumeration and dimension recurrence. For every integer \(s\ge1\), concatenation of within-block query trees yields \(\operatorname{Ldim}\ge5s\), while \(\operatorname{VCdim}=4s-1\) follows from the structural theorem. No larger-size equality is claimed.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete structural VC-shattering characterization and an exact formula at every order; explicit local adaptive trees prove a first gap at three elements and a two-round dimension gap on four labels, and direct-sum amplification yields an unbounded linear gap for ordinary Boolean pairwise comparisons in weak rankings. This motivates and uses the exact finite four-label witness as a structural building block, not an isolated census.
